Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
Does Mass Reality affect the damage the minion who strikes with a Bomb
takes?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
>
> Does Mass Reality affect the damage the minion who strikes with a Bomb
> takes?

No. It only affects the damage the weapon inflicts on the opposing minion (or
retainer) as a strike.
